prompt: What stays the same when gusts prevent outdoor kite flying?
promptZh: 陣風妨礙戶外放風箏時，哪一項維持不變？
evidence: we lead an indoor demonstration of kite assembly at the same time

options.text: The place where visitors collect kites.
options.zh: 參加者領取風箏的地點。
options.why: Indoor visitors do not collect kites.

options.text: The activities led by the instructor.
options.why: A kite assembly demonstration replaces outdoor flying.
options.whyZh: 改為室內風箏組裝示範，不再到戶外放風箏。

options.why: The replacement activity is scheduled for the same time.
options.whyZh: 替代活動安排在原時段。
